collection.title: Lamborghini Murcielago 2001 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Lamborghini Murcielago 2001 - 2010 requires a single front 28" wiper blade.All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
